newsitem.title: UK: Perez plans 300 bln lire bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Perez plans 300 bln lire bond - dealers.

text.p: Argentine holding company Perez Companc plans to launch a 300 billion lire five-year Eurobond, syndicate managers said on Wednesday.
The deal was expected to surface in the next few weeks. Chase was tipped as lead manager.
In January Perez Companc launched a $300 million seven-year bond in the U.S. 144A private placement market. The deal was priced to yield 252 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
Perez Companc is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service and BB-minus by Standard & Poor's.
The lira Eurobond sector has proved popular with emerging market borrowers. However, deals are limited by a strict queuing system imposed by the Bank of Italy.
Also in the pipeline is a 20-year bond for up to 500 billion lire from Brazil and a 500 billion lire seven-year issue for Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex).
